name: Silk Oreo Red Velvet
ingredients_raw: Milk Chocolate (50%*) - Sugar, Milk Solids (13 %*), Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifiers (442, 476), Flavours (Natural, Nature Identical and Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances); Centre (50%*) - Fractionated Fat, Sugar, Biscuit 13%* (Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Palmolein, Color (162), Invert Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Leavening Agents (500(ii), 503 (ii)), lodised Salt, Emulsifier (322), Flavours (Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances)), Milk Solids, Lactose-Rich Deproteinized Whey Permeate Powder, Flavours (Natural and Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances), Emulsifier (442). Allergen Information: Contains Milk, Wheat and Soy. May Contain Barley.
